content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Current digital payment platforms often restrict access in regions like Kenya, limiting creators' ability to monetize their work. COREMERCH's infrastructure uses decentralized blockchain technology, allowing you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments, you gain sovereignty over your commerce, removing reliance on traditional payment gateways that often exclude creators in Africa.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start, gather essential tools: a Cloudflare account for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Make sure to have your digital products ready, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates. You should also familiarize yourself with crypto wallets and exchanges, such as Binance P2P, which supports local currencies like the Kenyan shilling. These resources will ensure you have everything necessary for a successful deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment and delivery pipeline using the Sovereign Starter Stack. Create a GitHub Pages site to host your store, and set up Google Apps Script to manage orders and payments. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions and automate order confirmations. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to securely store and instantly deliver your digital products upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees that you control the entire process without interference from third-party platforms.
Leverage blockchain technology to eliminate payment restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your payment links to ensure that the transaction process works smoothly. Share your store link on social media platforms and relevant online communities to attract buyers. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment will be processed through NOWPayments, and the order will trigger an automatic delivery from your storage solution. Monitor the transaction to confirm that funds are received promptly, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, explore strategies to scale your business. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store. Consider expanding your product range or using analytics tools to gain insights into customer preferences. Leverage social media marketing to reach a broader audience and attract international buyers. As you grow, maintain your infrastructure's efficiency by regularly updating your tech stack and optimizing your delivery mechanisms.

Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Kenya without PayPal?

You can accept payments in Kenya without PayPal by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to receive funds in various cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring you have access to your earnings without reliance on conventional banking.
What digital products can I sell from my Kenyan store?

From your Kenyan store, you can sell various digital products such as ebooks, online courses, templates, and more. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows you to load any type of digital content you wish to monetize.
Is there a way to reach international buyers?

Yes, by using blockchain-based payments, you can reach international buyers seamlessly. Accepting cryptocurrencies removes geographic restrictions and allows you to engage with a global audience without traditional payment barriers.
What do I do if I encounter issues with transactions?

If you encounter issues with transactions, first check your payment processor settings. Ensure all integrations are correctly configured. If problems persist, consult the NOWPayments support documentation for troubleshooting or reach out for assistance.
